findings.problem: M1 finalization updates only the combined receipt. The bridge and smoke component receipts lack runner_process_exit_code and runner_process_seconds, while the trace auditor requires these actual process fields for each component. A successful M1 execution would therefore fail its subsequent audit.
findings.required_change: Bind component receipts to the actual common M1 child process exit and elapsed time, clearly label the time as covering the whole M1 process, recompute component self-hashes and combined references, and verify the finalization-to-audit receipt chain using a synthetic fixture. Preserve this M0 revision before rebinding.
